Agent Framework
content:
# Agent Framework

AIUI is an intent-driven development framework for building intelligent agents. Its goal is not only to render interfaces or execute page logic, but to turn user intent into a complete product flow: the agent understands intent, selects the right interaction form, runs the required logic, and continuously maps the result back into UI feedback.

At the implementation level, AIUI is built around two core layers:

- **Logic Layer**: Interprets intent and handles application, Page, Widget, and Agent Worker state, API calls, and events.
- **View Layer**: Uses Pages or Widgets to present information, collect input, and reflect state changes.

But AIUI is not defined only by the split between logic and UI. In a real agent project, the framework also works together with:

- `AGENTS.md`, which defines the agent's identity, goals, capabilities, and behavioral boundaries
- `app.json`, which declares Pages, Widgets, Agent Workers, and global configuration
- Pages and Widgets, which carry full interactions and compact at-a-glance interfaces
- Agent Workers, which manage shared tasks that do not belong to one interface

Together, these parts form a full loop from **intent understanding** to **interaction orchestration** to **interface feedback**.

## What You Will Learn

This section explains the framework from four perspectives:

- **Introduction**: Learn how AIUI organizes intent, runtime, and UI into one coherent framework.
- **Categories**: Understand different intent-carrying interaction forms, such as conversational AIUI and immersive AIUI.
- **Logic Development**: Learn how to organize Page, Widget, and Agent Worker lifecycle callbacks, state, and business logic around user intent.
- **User Interface (UI) Development**: Learn how to build Pages and Widgets with WXML, WXSS, and `.ink`.

## Suggested Reading Path

- If you are new to AIUI, start with **Introduction** to understand why AIUI is framed around intent rather than pages alone.
- Then read **Categories** to decide what interaction form should carry your product's intent.
- Continue with **Logic Development** to understand how intent is translated into state, lifecycle, and business behavior.
- Finally, read **User Interface (UI) Development** to connect intent-driven logic with a concrete interface.

For complete configuration and examples, see [Widget Development](/AIUI/framework/open-agent-format-widget) and [Agent Worker Development](/AIUI/framework/open-agent-format-agent-worker).

Use the sub-sections in the left-side menu to continue reading.

title: 智能体框架
content:
# 智能体框架

AIUI 是一套面向智能体的意图驱动开发框架。它关注的不只是把界面渲染出来，或者把页面逻辑跑起来，而是把用户意图组织成完整的产品流转过程：智能体理解意图、选择合适的交互形态、执行所需逻辑，并将结果持续映射成界面反馈。

在实现层面，AIUI 主要围绕两个核心层次展开：

- **逻辑层**：负责理解和承接意图，处理应用、Page、Widget 和 Agent Worker 的状态、API 调用与事件。
- **视图层**：通过 Page 或 Widget 呈现信息、收集操作输入，并把状态变化映射成可见反馈。

但 AIUI 的框架核心并不只是把逻辑和 UI 分开。在一个真实的智能体项目中，它还会和这些部分协同工作：

- `AGENTS.md`：定义智能体的身份、目标、能力与行为边界
- `app.json`：声明 Page、Widget、Agent Worker 和全局配置
- Page 与 Widget：分别承载完整交互和快速查看的小尺寸界面
- Agent Worker：管理不依赖某一个界面的共享任务

这些部分共同构成了一条从 **意图理解** 到 **交互编排** 再到 **界面反馈** 的完整链路。

## 你将学到什么

本章节会从四个角度帮助你理解这套意图驱动框架：

- **介绍**：理解 AIUI 如何把意图、运行时与界面组织成一套完整框架。
- **分类**：理解对话式 AIUI 和沉浸式 AIUI 这两种意图承载形态，以及它们各自适合的场景。
- **逻辑开发**：了解如何围绕用户意图组织 Page、Widget 和 Agent Worker 的生命周期、状态和业务逻辑。
- **用户界面（UI）开发**：了解如何使用 WXML、WXSS 和 `.ink` 构建 Page 与 Widget。

## 推荐阅读路径

- 如果你刚接触 AIUI，建议先阅读 **介绍**，理解为什么 AIUI 的核心是“意图驱动”，而不只是“页面驱动”。
- 然后阅读 **分类**，判断你的产品应该用什么交互形态来承载用户意图。
- 接着阅读 **逻辑开发**，理解意图如何被转化为状态、生命周期和业务行为。
- 最后阅读 **用户界面（UI）开发**，把意图驱动的逻辑连接到具体界面上。

Widget 和 Agent Worker 的完整配置与示例，分别参阅 [Widget 开发](/AIUI/framework/open-agent-format-widget) 和 [Agent Worker 开发](/AIUI/framework/open-agent-format-agent-worker)。

请在左侧菜单点击子栏目继续阅读。

title: Introduction
content:
# Introduction

The core of the AIUI agent framework is not simply "rendering a page." AIUI is an intent-driven development framework: developers describe what kind of agent they are building, what user intent should be captured, how that intent should be processed, and what interaction form should be used to return feedback. The runtime then connects these parts into a complete loop.

The interactive explanation below helps you understand the AIUI framework from two angles:

- What parts participate in the intent-to-feedback loop
- How a Page or Widget update happens at runtime

<framework-runtime-explorer></framework-runtime-explorer>

## Core Concepts

AIUI separates the logic layer from the view layer, but these layers work together with the agent description, application entry, Pages, Widgets, and Agent Workers:

1. **Agent Description**: Defined by `AGENTS.md`, which specifies the agent's identity, description, capabilities, and system instructions, determining how the platform understands what kinds of intent this agent should handle.
2. **Agent Entry (Application Entry)**: Defined by `app.json`, which declares Pages, Widgets, Agent Workers, and global configuration.
3. **Logic Layer**: Interprets user actions, runs business logic, calls APIs, and manages data. Agent Workers can own shared tasks that do not belong to one interface.
4. **View Layer**: Pages carry complete interactions, while Widgets provide compact information and quick actions. Both can use data binding, components, and styles.

This architecture provides smooth interface updates while letting developers separately organize the intent, choose between a Page and a Widget, decide which tasks must be shared, and define how the interface responds.

title: 介绍
content:
# 介绍

AIUI 智能体框架的核心，不只是“把页面渲染出来”，而是把它作为一套意图驱动开发框架来组织。开发者需要定义智能体要承接什么样的用户意图、这些意图如何被处理，以及最终通过什么交互形态把反馈返回给用户；运行时再把这些部分串成一条完整链路。

下面这个交互式说明会从两个角度帮助你理解 AIUI 框架：

- 意图到反馈的完整链路由哪些部分组成
- 一个 Page 或 Widget 更新在运行时是怎么发生的

<framework-runtime-explorer></framework-runtime-explorer>

## 核心概念

AIUI 采用逻辑层与视图层分离设计，但这个分层并不是孤立存在的，而是和智能体描述、应用入口、Page、Widget 与 Agent Worker 一起协同工作：

1. **智能体描述 (Agent Description)**：由 `AGENTS.md` 定义智能体的身份、描述、能力和系统指令，决定平台如何理解这个智能体应当承接哪些意图。
2. **智能体入口 (Application Entry)**：由 `app.json` 声明 Page、Widget、Agent Worker 和全局配置，决定应用包含哪些入口与任务。
3. **逻辑层 (Logic Layer)**：负责解释用户操作、处理业务逻辑、调用 API 和管理数据状态。Agent Worker 可以承担不依赖某一个界面的共享任务。
4. **视图层 (View Layer)**：Page 承载完整交互，Widget 提供便于快速查看或操作的小尺寸界面；两者都可以使用数据绑定、组件和样式。

这种架构不仅能提供流畅的界面更新能力，也让开发者能够把“智能体要承接什么意图”“用 Page 还是 Widget 展示”“哪些任务需要共享”“界面如何反馈”拆开组织。

title: Logic Development
逻辑开发
User Interface (UI) Development
用户界面 (UI) 开发
Overview
content:
# Overview

If this is your first time seeing AIUI, you can think of it as a framework for building agents that are intelligent, interactive, and designed for new kinds of devices.

It is not just a chatbot, and it is not only a traditional UI framework. AIUI is a way to organize **AI capabilities**, **user interfaces**, **device capabilities**, and **agent logic** into one product, so developers can build intelligent agents that people can actually use.

![AIUI connects AI, interactive interfaces, and capabilities across devices](../image/overview/aiui-ecosystem.png)

From lightweight prompts on glasses to persistent task interfaces and access to cameras, voice, and sensors, AIUI lets the same agent combine the right interaction and device capabilities for each context.

## What Is AIUI Mainly Used For?

In one sentence:

**AIUI is used to build interactive AI agents where AI does not just answer, but also understands, acts, and returns feedback.**

In a normal AI chat product, the interaction often stays in text: the user asks something, and the model replies.

In AIUI, after the user gives a request, the system can:

- understand what the user wants to do
- choose the right interaction form for that request
- call pages, components, network APIs, device features, or AI capabilities to complete the task
- return the result through UI, cards, state changes, voice, or other forms of feedback

That makes AIUI more suitable for products like these:

- intelligent agents that can both chat and operate through UI
- agents running on AI glasses, AR devices, or other smart terminals
- products that need both AI understanding and real interaction flows
- agents that need not only "answers", but also execution and feedback

## How Is AIUI Different from a Traditional App?

A traditional app framework mostly focuses on questions like:

- How should a page be written?
- How should data be updated?
- How should a button respond?

AIUI also cares about those things, but it goes further:

- What is the user's real intent right now?
- What is the right way to carry that intent?
- When should the system show UI, and when is a plain answer enough?
- When should it call AI, and when should it call device capabilities?
- Does the user need continuous feedback instead of a one-time result?

So AIUI is not only a "page development framework". It is better understood as an **intent-driven development framework**.

## What Is the Overall Architecture of AIUI?

At a high level, you can understand AIUI as four parts:

1. **Agent Definition**
2. **Interaction Interface**
3. **Runtime Logic**
4. **Underlying Capabilities**

These parts work together in one loop:

**The user makes a request -> the system understands the intent -> the agent decides how to handle it -> UI and capabilities complete the task together -> the result is returned to the user**

![The AIUI interaction loop from user request to feedback](../image/overview/interaction-loop.png)

This is not a pipeline that runs only once. The user can act on the feedback or clarify their intent, and the agent begins another cycle of understanding, execution, and feedback.

Here is what each part means.

### 1. Agent Definition

This part defines who the agent is, what it can do, what it is good at, and where its boundaries are.

For example:

- Is it a weather assistant or a navigation assistant?
- Is it good at searching information or controlling devices?
- What tone should it use when talking to users?
- When should it show UI, and when is a text response enough?

This is often described in files such as `AGENTS.md`.

You can think of it as: **setting the identity and working style of the agent**.

### 2. Interaction Interface

This part defines what the user sees, what they can tap, and how they continue the interaction.

In AIUI, the interface is not just decoration. It is part of the interaction itself. It can be:

- a card inside a chat
- a standalone page
- an at-a-glance Widget
- a panel of buttons
- a set of status hints
- a continuously updating task interface

In other words, UI in AIUI is not only for displaying content. It is used to carry user intent, collect user actions, and return system feedback.

### 3. Runtime Logic

This part defines how the system handles things internally.

For example:

- when a Page or Widget is shown
- which shared tasks an Agent Worker manages
- what should happen after the user taps a button
- how network data is requested
- how state is updated
- how new results are synced back to the interface

You can think of this as the brain and flow-control layer of the agent.

### 4. Underlying Capabilities

This part defines what real capabilities the system can use.

Examples include:

- AI capabilities: speech recognition, speech synthesis, large language models
- network capabilities: requesting remote APIs and getting real-time data
- device capabilities: connecting BLE peripherals, reading sensors, and using cameras
- rendering capabilities: showing the interface efficiently on the device

If the interface is what users can see, and logic is what makes things work, then underlying capabilities are what make things actually possible.

## What Parts Does AIUI Include?

If you look at AIUI itself rather than the documentation structure, you can first understand it as six parts:

![The six core AIUI modules and how they relate](../image/overview/architecture.en-US.svg)

The diagram shows how these modules work together: the **Agent Framework** organizes the application, **Built-in Components** and **APIs** provide the interface and capabilities, and the **Ink Runtime** executes them. **Design Guidelines** and **Developer Tools** support the entire development process.

### 1. Agent Framework

This is the upper-level organization model of AIUI. It defines how an agent is described, how user intent is handled, and how pages, logic, and interaction flows are organized.

This layer answers questions like:

- What is an agent?
- How is user intent carried?
- What is the difference between conversational and immersive interaction?
- How are Pages, Widgets, Agent Workers, logic, and state organized together?

You can think of it as: **the structural model and interaction organization of AIUI**.

### 2. Agent Runtime (Ink)

This is the underlying runtime foundation of AIUI. It runs code, drives Pages and Widgets, and executes Agent Worker background tasks.

This layer answers questions like:

- Where does the code actually run?
- How are Page or Widget updates executed?
- How does the runtime connect UI, logic, and underlying capabilities?
- Why can AIUI run on AI glasses, AR devices, and similar terminals?

You can think of it as: **the execution engine of AIUI**.

### 3. Built-in Components

These are the ready-to-use UI components provided by AIUI to help developers build agent interfaces quickly.

Examples include:

- basic display components
- interactive components
- media components
- AI-related components

This part solves the problem of "how the interface is built". You do not need to build every interface from scratch each time.

### 4. API

These are the capability interfaces provided by AIUI for developers to call.

Examples include:

- networking
- storage
- device capabilities
- AI capabilities
- canvas and media capabilities

This part solves the problem of "what the agent can do". Components handle how the interface is shown, while APIs connect real capabilities into the system.

### 5. Design Guidelines

These are the basic visual, interaction, and device-experience rules of AIUI.

They help developers understand:

- how an interface should better fit AI interaction
- how information should be presented on AI glasses, AR devices, and similar scenarios
- what kinds of layout, hierarchy, and feedback work better for continuous interaction

This part solves the problem of "how to design a better and more usable agent".

### 6. Developer Tools

These are the supporting tools around the full AIUI development workflow.

Examples include:

- CLI
- debugging tools
- packaging and publishing tools
- performance analysis and diagnostics tools

This part solves the problem of "how to actually develop, debug, and ship an agent".

If you put these six parts together, you can understand them like this:

- **Agent Framework** decides how things are organized
- **Agent Runtime (Ink)** decides how things run
- **Built-in Components** decide how things are displayed
- **API** decides what the agent can do
- **Design Guidelines** decide how to design things better
- **Developer Tools** decide how things are developed and shipped

## The Simplest Way to Remember It

If all of the above still feels like a lot, remember this sentence first:

**AIUI = AI + UI + agent logic + device capabilities**

And one step further:

**AIUI is a development framework that brings AI into the real interaction flow of a product.**

It does not only make AI talk. It makes AI able to:

- understand what the user wants right now
- decide how to respond
- call the right interface and capabilities
- continuously return process and result feedback to the user

## What Should You Read Next?

If you finish this page, a good next reading order is:

1. **Concept Introduction**: understand the core terms first
2. **Project Structure**: learn how an AIUI project is organized
3. **Agent Framework**: understand the core way AIUI works
4. **Quick Start**: build your first AIUI agent

If you are still a beginner, that is completely fine. You do not need to understand every technical detail at once. As long as you first understand what AIUI is for, and then gradually learn how it works, you are already on the right path.

title: 总览
content:
# 总览

如果你是第一次接触 AIUI，可以先把它理解成一套用来开发“有智能、能交互、能运行在新型设备上的智能体”的框架。

它不是单纯的聊天机器人，也不只是一个普通的界面框架。AIUI 更像是一套把 **AI 能力**、**用户界面**、**设备能力** 和 **智能体逻辑** 组织到一起的开发方式，让开发者可以做出真正可用的智能体产品。

![AIUI 将 AI、交互界面与多种设备能力连接在一起](../image/overview/aiui-ecosystem.png)

从眼镜上的轻量提示，到可持续操作的任务界面，再到摄像头、语音和传感器，AIUI 让同一个智能体可以按场景组合不同的交互与设备能力。

## AIUI 主要是做什么的？

一句话来说：

**AIUI 用来开发面向 AI 场景的交互式智能体，让 AI 不只是“会回答”，而是“会理解、会操作、会反馈”。**

比如，一个普通的 AI 对话产品，用户问一句，模型答一句，交互基本停留在文本里。

但在 AIUI 里，用户提出需求之后，系统可以：

- 理解用户现在想做什么
- 选择合适的交互方式来承接这个需求
- 调用页面、组件、网络、设备或 AI 能力去完成任务
- 把结果通过界面、卡片、状态变化、语音或其他反馈方式返回给用户

这意味着 AIUI 更适合做下面这类产品：

- 能对话，也能操作界面的智能体
- 运行在 AI 眼镜、AR 设备、终端设备上的智能体
- 既需要 AI 理解能力，也需要真实交互流程的智能体产品
- 既有“回答”，也有“执行”和“反馈”的智能体

## AIUI 和普通应用（App）有什么不同？

普通应用（App）框架更关心这些问题：

- 页面怎么写
- 数据怎么更新
- 按钮怎么响应

而 AIUI 除了这些，还更关心下面的问题：

- 用户现在的真实意图是什么
- 系统应该用什么方式承接这个意图
- 什么时候应该展示界面，什么时候应该直接回答
- 什么时候应该调用 AI，什么时候应该调用设备能力
- 用户是否需要持续反馈，而不是一次性结果

所以，AIUI 不只是一个“页面开发框架”，更是一套 **意图驱动的开发框架**。

## AIUI 的整体架构是什么？

你可以先把 AIUI 的整体架构理解成四个部分：

1. **智能体定义**
2. **交互界面**
3. **运行逻辑**
4. **底层能力**

它们一起工作，形成一条完整链路：

**用户提出需求 -> 系统理解意图 -> 智能体决定怎么处理 -> 界面和能力一起完成任务 -> 结果反馈给用户**

![AIUI 从用户请求到结果反馈的交互闭环](../image/overview/interaction-loop.png)

这不是一条只执行一次的流水线。用户可以根据反馈继续操作或补充意图，智能体再进入下一轮理解、执行与反馈。

下面分别解释。

### 1. 智能体定义

这一层决定“这个智能体是谁、会做什么、擅长什么、边界是什么”。

比如：

- 它是一个天气助手，还是一个导航助手
- 它擅长查资料，还是擅长帮用户操作设备
- 它应该用什么语气和用户沟通
- 它在什么情况下应该展示 UI，什么情况下只需要文字回复

这一部分通常由像 `AGENTS.md` 这样的描述文件来承载。

你可以把它理解成：**给智能体设定身份和工作方式**。

### 2. 交互界面

这一层决定“用户看到什么、点什么、怎么继续操作”。

在 AIUI 里，界面不只是装饰，而是交互的一部分。它可以是：

- 聊天中的卡片
- 一个独立页面
- 一个便于快速查看的 Widget
- 一个按钮面板
- 一组状态提示
- 一个持续更新的任务界面

也就是说，AIUI 里的 UI 不是单纯“把内容显示出来”，而是用来承接用户意图、收集用户操作、返回系统反馈的。

### 3. 运行逻辑

这一层决定“系统内部怎么处理事情”。

比如：

- Page 或 Widget 什么时候显示
- 哪些共享任务由 Agent Worker 管理
- 用户点击按钮后要做什么
- 如何请求网络数据
- 如何更新状态
- 如何把新结果同步到界面上

这部分可以理解成智能体的“大脑和流程控制层”。

### 4. 底层能力

这一层决定“系统到底能调用什么真实能力”。

例如：

- AI 能力：语音识别、语音播报、大语言模型
- 网络能力：请求远程接口、获取实时数据
- 设备能力：连接 BLE 外设、读取传感器或使用摄像头
- 渲染能力：把界面高效显示在设备上

如果说界面负责“看得见”，逻辑负责“想得通”，那么底层能力负责“做得到”。

## AIUI 分成哪几个部分？

如果从 AIUI 自身的构成来看，你可以把它先理解成下面六个部分：

![AIUI 六个核心模块及其关系](../image/overview/architecture.svg)

上图展示了这些模块如何配合：**智能体框架** 负责组织应用，**内置组件** 和 **API** 分别承接界面与能力，最终由 **Ink 运行时** 执行；**设计规范** 与 **开发者工具** 则贯穿整个开发过程。

### 1. 智能体框架

这是 AIUI 的上层组织方式，决定智能体如何被定义、如何理解用户意图、如何组织页面、逻辑和交互流程。

这一层回答的是：

- 智能体是什么
- 用户意图如何被承接
- 对话式和沉浸式交互有什么区别
- Page、Widget、Agent Worker、逻辑和状态是怎么组织起来的

你可以把它理解成：**AIUI 的“大脑结构”和交互组织方式**。

### 2. 智能体运行时（Ink）

这是 AIUI 的底层运行基础，负责执行代码、驱动 Page 与 Widget，并运行 Agent Worker 后台任务。

这一层回答的是：

- 代码最终在哪里运行
- Page 或 Widget 更新是如何被执行的
- 运行时如何连接界面、逻辑和底层能力
- 为什么 AIUI 可以运行在 AI 眼镜、AR 设备等终端上

你可以把它理解成：**AIUI 的“运行引擎”**。

### 3. 内置组件

这是 AIUI 提供的一组现成 UI 组件，用来帮助开发者快速搭建智能体界面。

例如：

- 基础展示组件
- 交互组件
- 媒体组件
- AI 相关组件

这一部分解决的是“界面怎么搭起来”的问题。你不需要每次都从零开始写所有界面结构，而是可以直接复用 AIUI 提供的组件能力。

### 4. API

这是 AIUI 提供给开发者调用的能力接口。

例如：

- 网络请求
- 存储
- 设备能力
- AI 能力
- 画布和多媒体能力

这一部分解决的是“智能体能做什么”的问题。组件负责把界面展示出来，API 则负责把真实能力接进来。

### 5. 设计规范

这是 AIUI 在视觉、交互和设备体验上的一套基础约束。

它会帮助开发者理解：

- 界面应该怎样更适合 AI 交互
- 在 AI 眼镜、AR 设备等场景下，信息应该如何展示
- 什么样的布局、层级和反馈更适合持续交互

这一部分解决的是“智能体应该怎样设计得更合理、更易用”的问题。

### 6. 开发者工具

这是围绕 AIUI 开发流程配套的一整套工具能力。

例如：

- CLI
- 调试工具
- 打包与发布工具
- 性能分析与诊断工具

这一部分解决的是“怎么把智能体真正开发出来、调试好、发布出去”的问题。

如果把上面六部分放在一起理解，那么可以这样看：

- **智能体框架** 决定“怎么组织”
- **智能体运行时（Ink）** 决定“怎么运行”
- **内置组件** 决定“怎么展示”
- **API** 决定“能做什么”
- **设计规范** 决定“怎么设计得更好”
- **开发者工具** 决定“怎么开发和发布”

## 一个最简单的理解方式

如果你觉得上面还是有点多，可以先记住下面这句话：

**AIUI = AI + UI + 智能体逻辑 + 设备能力**

再进一步一点，就是：

**AIUI 是一套让 AI 真正进入产品交互流程的开发框架。**

它不只是让 AI 说话，而是让 AI 能够：

- 理解用户现在要做什么
- 决定应该怎么回应
- 调用合适的界面和能力
- 持续把过程和结果反馈给用户

## 建议你接下来读什么

如果你已经读完这篇，可以继续按下面顺序阅读：

1. **概念介绍**：先把核心名词都弄明白
2. **项目结构**：了解一个 AIUI 项目是怎么组织的
3. **智能体框架**：理解 AIUI 的核心工作方式
4. **快速开始**：开始动手写第一个 AIUI 智能体

如果你现在还是新手，也完全没关系。你不需要一次把所有技术细节都看懂，只要先知道 AIUI 是“用来做什么的”，再逐步理解“它是怎么做的”，就已经是一个非常好的开始。

title: Performance Metrics
content:
# Performance Metrics

Performance work starts with observable data. In AIUI, the most useful metrics usually span startup, rendering, script execution, and networking.

## What To Measure

- Startup time: time from launch until the first visible screen
- First render: time before the page becomes meaningfully interactive
- JavaScript execution: cost of initialization, data processing, and callbacks
- Network latency: response time, retries, and failure rate under poor connectivity
- Memory usage: whether usage keeps growing after navigation or during long sessions

## How To Use These Metrics

- First decide whether the issue belongs to [Startup Performance](/AIUI/guide/performance-startup) or [Runtime Performance](/AIUI/guide/performance-runtime)
- Establish baselines for critical flows instead of relying only on subjective feel
- Review page metrics together with request metrics so the bottleneck is not misidentified

## Next Step

For deeper issue isolation, continue with [Performance Diagnostics](/AIUI/guide/performance-tool).

title: 性能数据
content:
# 性能数据

性能优化首先要建立在可观测的数据之上。AIUI 中常见的性能数据通常覆盖启动、渲染、脚本执行和网络请求四类问题。

## 重点关注哪些指标

- 启动耗时：从启动到首个可见界面的耗时
- 首次渲染：页面首次可交互前的布局与绘制时间
- JavaScript 执行：初始化脚本、数据处理和事件回调的耗时
- 网络延迟：接口响应时间、重试次数和弱网下的失败率
- 内存占用：页面切换后是否持续增长，以及长时间运行是否出现抖动

## 如何使用这些数据

- 先区分问题发生在 [启动性能](/AIUI/guide/performance-startup) 还是 [运行时性能](/AIUI/guide/performance-runtime)
- 对关键链路建立基线，避免只凭主观体感判断快慢
- 把页面级指标和接口级指标一起看，避免误判瓶颈位置

## 下一步

需要进一步定位具体问题时，继续参考 [性能诊断工具](/AIUI/guide/performance-tool)。

title: Full-Color Optimization Guide
content:
# Full-Color Optimization Guide

Full-color optimization makes results easier to read and actions easier to complete using a 480 × 352 full-screen reference or a 480-wide card reference with adaptive height, while keeping the agent responsive. First establish compatibility with the [Full-Color Glasses Adaptation Guide](/AIUI/guide/framework/full-color), then refine the experience using the [Full-Color Visual Guidelines](/AIUI/design/visual-full-color).

## Reduce Information Before Adjusting Typography

Let each view answer one main question, such as the current status, the next direction, or whether a task succeeded. Put the primary result and essential actions first, and move supporting detail into a detail view or later steps.

- Show a summary of a long response before offering details or scrolling.
- Show the most relevant list entries first, with pagination or scrolling for the rest.
- Show key metrics or a small number of chart series, with labels and units.
- Make empty, loading, and error states understandable and actionable within the same area.

Reflow full-screen and card layouts for their actual container dimensions; card height adapts to content. Keep text at 14–24 dp, icons at least 12 × 12, and reserve space for card margins, padding, and strokes.

## Use Bright Colors for Emphasis

Prefer `--color-text-primary` for body text, `--color-text-secondary` for supporting content, and theme accents for a few important elements. Keep status color meanings consistent and pair them with text or icons.

Avoid coloring everything with an accent or adding large fills to improve contrast. Pure black is transparent, and dark details can disappear. If content is difficult to read, reduce clutter and increase foreground brightness and alpha, then verify on the glasses.

Set alpha separately for borders, dividers, and text to avoid compounding whole-card opacity. Keep the outermost card borderless. Internal cards use a 1px white border at 30% alpha by default and 100% when selected or focused, without changing its width. Dividers remain 1px at 40% alpha. Keep muted text, icons, and other content at or above the recommended 40% alpha.

## Inspect Images, Charts, and Canvas Separately

Theme tokens cannot directly replace image pixels or hardcoded Canvas drawing colors. Inspect these resources individually:

| Content | Optimization |
| --- | --- |
| Images | Prepare assets for their display size; reduce irrelevant backgrounds, dark details, and embedded small text |
| Icons | Use clear silhouettes and sufficient size; retain readable assets for monochrome and unknown capabilities |
| Charts | Reduce series, grid lines, and labels; prefer lines and outlines, and do not rely only on color for critical distinctions |
| Canvas | Reflow for available space; explicitly set readable fonts, line widths, and bright colors, and inspect clipping and labels |
| Maps | Retain essential routes, positions, and labels while reducing filled surfaces and unrelated details |

Arrange covers, titles, body content, charts, and footers within the available inner space. Card height follows its content. Account for headings, charts, actions, spacing, and internal card borders and padding within the available space. Split summary and detail when needed, or choose the presentation that best supports the current task.

## Keep Actions and Focus Visible

Make internal card focus visible with a clear white outline at 100% alpha, with more than a color change alone; the outermost layout card stays borderless. Verify confirmation, back navigation, and scrolling through the core task, including access to actions in long content.

Do not assume that temple input mappings match another model. Verify interaction on the target device. Understand default actions before handling custom keys to avoid duplicate confirmation or lost back navigation. See the [Focus System](/AIUI/framework/open-agent-format-page-focus) and [Page Events](/AIUI/framework/open-agent-format-page-events).

## Control Assets and Update Frequency

Full color does not require more animation, images, or continuous refresh. Show useful results first and load decorative assets as needed. Avoid loading every palette variant together.

Coalesce state updates when newer values replace older ones, and avoid relaying out an entire page for every streamed character. Bound lists and caches. Pause unnecessary refresh, animation, and media when hidden, and release listeners and resources on unload. See [Runtime Performance](/AIUI/guide/performance-runtime) and [Startup Performance](/AIUI/guide/performance-startup).

## Verify Improvements with the Same Inputs

Record the target model, system and runtime versions, agent package version, input data, and test scenario. Keep these conditions consistent when comparing first content, reading, repeated interaction, and extended use.

| Scenario | What to Check |
| --- | --- |
| Bright and complex real backgrounds | Readability of primary and secondary text, lines, and focus |
| Long titles, long text, and multiple results | Adaptation to actual container dimensions and access to essential content and actions |
| Empty, loading, failure, and retry states | Clear explanations and next actions, with more than color alone |
| Repeated scrolling, navigation, and back actions | Stable focus, smooth interaction, and no unnecessary background work |
| Monochrome, full color, and unknown-capability fallback | Consistent shared flows, readable assets, and essential actions |

Use simulation to investigate layout and logic quickly. Confirm color, see-through readability, actual interaction, and performance through [Real-Device Debugging](/AIUI/guide/debug-real_device_debug). A single desktop preview or successful package build does not establish that optimization is complete.

title: 全彩优化指南
content:
# 全彩优化指南

全彩优化的目标是在全屏 480 × 352 或卡片宽 480、高度自适应的参考尺寸下，让结果更容易读、操作更容易完成，并保持稳定运行。先按[全彩眼镜适配指南](/AIUI/guide/framework/full-color)完成兼容，再依据[全彩视觉规范](/AIUI/design/visual-full-color)优化体验。

## 先减少信息，再调整排版

每个视图先回答一个主要问题，例如“现在是什么状态”“下一步去哪里”“这次任务是否成功”。把主要结果与必要操作放在首屏，辅助说明放入详情或后续步骤。

- 长段回答先显示摘要，再让用户进入详情或滚动阅读。
- 列表先展示当前最相关的条目，通过分页或滚动访问其余内容。
- 图表先展示关键指标或少量系列，保留标签和单位。
- 空态、加载态和错误态也要能在同一区域内读懂并继续操作。

全屏和卡片应根据实际容器尺寸重新排版，卡片高度随内容自适应；字号保持 14～24 dp，图标不小于 12 × 12，并为卡片外边距、内边距和描边保留空间。

## 用亮色表达重点

正文优先使用 `--color-text-primary`，次级内容使用 `--color-text-secondary`，少量重点使用主题强调色。保持同一状态的颜色语义一致，并配上文字或图标。

不要把所有内容都染成强调色，也不要通过增加大面积填充改善对比。纯黑会透明，深色细节容易消失；看不清时先减少噪声、提高前景亮度与 alpha，再到真机验证。

为边框、分割线与文字分别设置 alpha，避免卡片整体透明度叠加。最外层卡片无边框；内部卡片使用 1px 白色描边，默认 alpha 30%，选中或聚焦时为 100%，宽度不变。分割线保持 1px、alpha 40%；文字、图标等内容弱化时建议仍不低于 40%。

## 单独检查图片、图表和 Canvas

主题 Token 无法直接替换图片像素或 Canvas 中写死的绘图颜色。逐项检查这些资源：

| 内容 | 优化方向 |
| --- | --- |
| 图片 | 按实际展示尺寸准备资源，减少无关背景、暗色细节与图片内小字 |
| 图标 | 使用轮廓清晰、尺寸足够的资源；为单色与未知显示能力保留可读版本 |
| 图表 | 精简系列、网格和标签，优先线条与轮廓；不要仅用颜色区分关键数据 |
| Canvas | 随可用空间重新布局，明确设置可读字体、线宽和亮色；检查裁剪与标注 |
| 地图 | 保留必要路线、点位与标注，减少面状填色和不相关细节 |

根据内部内容空间安排封面、标题、正文、图表和页脚。卡片高度随内容变化，内部卡片的描边和内边距也需计入可用空间，标题、图表、操作与它们之间的间距需共同计入预算；内容过多时拆成摘要与详情，或选择最能支持当前任务的展示方式。

## 保持操作与焦点可见

内部卡片的焦点应通过清晰的 100% 白色描边可见，不要只变换颜色；最外层布局卡片始终无边框。检查确认、返回和滚动是否能完成核心任务，尤其要确认长内容中的操作可以到达。

不要直接复用另一型号的镜腿按键假设。用目标设备验证交互；处理自定义按键前先明确默认行为，避免重复确认或吞掉返回。页面焦点与事件可参考[焦点系统](/AIUI/framework/open-agent-format-page-focus)和[页面事件](/AIUI/framework/open-agent-format-page-events)。

## 控制资源与更新频率

全彩并不意味着需要更多动画、图片或持续刷新。优先显示有效结果，装饰资源按需加载；不要为了全彩表现同时加载所有配色变体。

合并可以被新值替代的状态更新，避免流式输出每到一个字符就触发整页布局。限制列表和缓存长度；页面隐藏时暂停不必要的刷新、动画和媒体，卸载时释放监听与资源。具体方法见[运行时性能](/AIUI/guide/performance-runtime)和[启动性能](/AIUI/guide/performance-startup)。

## 用相同输入验证改进

记录目标型号、系统与运行时版本、智能体包版本、数据输入和测试场景。保持这些条件一致，再比较首屏、阅读、连续操作与长时间运行表现。

| 场景 | 检查重点 |
| --- | --- |
| 浅色与复杂真实背景 | 正文、次级文字、线条与焦点是否可辨 |
| 长标题、长文本、多条结果 | 是否适应实际容器尺寸，关键内容与操作是否仍可达 |
| 空态、加载、失败、重试 | 是否有明确说明和下一步，状态是否只靠颜色表达 |
| 连续滚动、切页、返回 | 焦点是否稳定，是否出现卡顿或后台任务持续运行 |
| 单色、全彩与未知能力回退 | 共用流程是否一致，是否仍有可读资源和必要操作 |

模拟器适合快速排查布局与逻辑；颜色、透视可读性、实际交互和性能应通过[真机调试](/AIUI/guide/debug-real_device_debug)确认。不要仅凭一次桌面预览或打包成功认定优化完成。

title: Poor Network Experience
content:
# Poor Network Experience

Poor network experience is not only about slow requests. It also includes whether loading feedback is clear, whether failures recover well, and whether the page remains usable under high latency.

## Design Priorities

- Show loading feedback early so the page does not feel frozen
- Define timeouts, retries, and failure messaging for critical requests
- Keep core information visible first and defer secondary content
- Reuse locally cached data when appropriate to avoid repeated requests

## Common Optimization Directions

- Build a consistent request layer based on [Usage](/AIUI/guide/basic-network-usage)
- When using [HTTPS](/AIUI/api/network-https), handle timeouts, status errors, and degraded messaging explicitly
- For real-time streaming flows, evaluate recovery behavior for [Event Source](/AIUI/api/network-event-source) or [WebSocket](/AIUI/api/network-websocket)

## Verification Tips

- Validate first load, reconnect, and resume-from-background scenarios under real poor-network conditions
- Check both chat-card and immersive pages for clear user feedback

title: 弱网体验
content:
# 弱网体验

弱网体验并不只是“请求慢”，还包括加载反馈是否清晰、失败后能否恢复，以及页面在高延迟场景下是否仍然可用。

## 设计重点

- 尽早展示加载状态，避免让用户误以为页面失去响应
- 为关键请求设置超时、重试和失败提示
- 优先保证核心信息可见，把次要内容延后加载
- 对可缓存的数据做本地复用，减少重复请求

## 常见优化方向

- 结合 [使用说明](/AIUI/guide/basic-network-usage) 设计统一的请求层
- 使用 [HTTPS](/AIUI/api/network-https) 时显式处理超时、错误码和降级文案
- 对实时流式场景评估 [Event Source](/AIUI/api/network-event-source) 或 [WebSocket](/AIUI/api/network-websocket) 的恢复策略

## 验证建议

- 在真实弱网环境下验证首次加载、重连和返回前台场景
- 分别检查卡片态与沉浸态页面是否都具备明确反馈

title: Runtime Performance
运行时性能
Startup Performance
content:
# Startup Performance

AIUI startup performance is primarily determined by how much work the first Page or Widget must complete between opening the agent and showing the first meaningful frame.

During startup, the AIUI runtime reads and parses the entry source, merges global and page styles, parses the template and creates its node trees, loads custom components used by the initial screen, executes the application and entry scripts, and applies the initial `data` to template bindings. It then performs the first binding, layout, and paint work before submitting a frame to the display.

The goal is therefore not merely to reduce the total project size, but to shorten this initial-screen critical path.

## Keep the Initial Screen Small

The larger the initial template is, the more nodes the runtime must parse, bind, lay out, and paint before the first frame. Keep only content that users can see or use immediately on the entry page.

- Do not mount large lists, complex panels, or deeply nested structures that are not needed on the initial screen.
- Move later workflows to subsequent pages and load them when users enter those workflows.
- Start lists with a reasonable number of items instead of placing the entire dataset in `data`.
- Remove wrapper nodes that do not contribute layout, styling, or interaction.

Hiding content with CSS does not remove it from template parsing and node creation. For a complete feature area that is not needed during startup, remove it from the initial-screen structure instead of merely making it invisible.

### Split Independent Screens into Separate Pages

If the home, detail, and settings screens each serve a distinct task, implement them as separate Pages. Do not put every screen's template, state, and event logic into one Page and switch the complete interface with `ink:if` and page state. That approach keeps expanding the entry template and script while coupling the lifecycle, data, and interaction logic of otherwise independent screens.

For example, this structure places both the home and detail screens in one Page and does not scale well as features grow:

```html
<page>
  <view ink:if="{{ currentView === 'home' }}">
    <!-- Home content -->
  </view>

  <view ink:elif="{{ currentView === 'detail' }}">
    <!-- Detail content -->
  </view>
</page>
```

Instead, register the two Pages separately in `app.json`:

```json
{
  "pages": [
    "pages/home/index",
    "pages/detail/index"
  ]
}
```

Navigate from the home Page when the user opens a detail item:

```javascript
wx.navigateTo({
  url: '/pages/detail/index?id=42'
});
```

The entry Page now handles only the home task, while the detail Page keeps its own template, state, and business logic. Use `wx.redirectTo()` when the new Page should replace the current one, and `wx.navigateBack()` to return through the existing page stack.

`ink:if` remains appropriate for local conditions within one Page, such as loading, empty, error, and permission states or an expandable region. Use this rule of thumb: if the content represents a distinct task, complete layout, or navigation destination, prefer a separate Page; if it is only a local state of the current task, keep it in the current Page. See the [Routing API](/AIUI/api/route) for the complete navigation contract.

## Limit Custom Components on the Initial Screen

While parsing the entry template, the runtime loads referenced custom components and executes their scripts. A component's template, styles, nested components, and initialization code therefore become part of the startup critical path.

- Reference only custom components that the initial screen needs immediately.
- Avoid a deeply nested component tree for small static fragments.
- Check whether nested components repeatedly import the same resources or perform the same initialization.
- Move complex, nonessential features to later pages instead of mounting them on the entry page in advance.

Components remain valuable for maintainability, but a component boundary does not automatically provide lazy loading. Decide whether to reference a component based on whether the initial screen actually needs it.

## Reduce Synchronous Script and Resource Initialization

The application script, entry script, and initial-screen component scripts all run during startup. Synchronous work at module scope directly delays subsequent lifecycle work and the first frame.

- Do not transform large arrays, deeply clone objects, or repeatedly parse JSON at module scope.
- Do not create unused media, device, or other heavyweight objects during startup.
- Defer calculations and capability initialization that are not required by the initial screen until users enter the relevant workflow.
- Be careful when importing assets with `with { type: 'image' }` or `with { type: 'sound' }` from an entry module; the runtime decodes images or initializes sound objects while evaluating those modules.

Keep synchronous work in `onLoad` short as well. The initial screen can show a stable loading state while a network request runs, then update when data arrives:

```html
<script setup>
export default {
  data: {
    loading: true,
    items: [],
  },

  async onLoad() {
    const response = await fetch('https://api.example.com/items');
    const items = await response.json();

    this.setData({
      loading: false,
      items,
    });
  },
};
</script>
```

This does not remove network latency, but it prevents remote data from becoming a prerequisite for the first frame. Keep loading, empty, and error states dimensionally stable to reduce visible layout shifts when data arrives.

## Keep Initial `data` and Bindings Focused

After executing the entry script, the runtime reads the initial `data` and applies those fields to template bindings. Large objects, long lists, and many expressions increase initial data conversion and binding work.

- Keep only fields required to render the initial screen in initial `data`.
- Do not copy a complete API response into page state; extract the fields the UI actually uses.
- Avoid repeatedly reading the same deeply nested fields from many nodes.
- Apply related changes from one operation with one `setData()` call instead of triggering several consecutive updates.

Do not combine unrelated large objects into `setData()` merely to reduce the number of calls. The goal is to avoid redundant rendering while keeping every update focused on necessary data.

## Optimize Initial Styles and Media

The runtime parses global and page styles before constructing the initial screen and resolves styles while laying out nodes. Resources such as initial-screen images may continue loading after the first update and trigger another paint when they become available.

- Remove unused global styles so every page does not pay to parse unrelated rules.
- Limit complex selectors and deeply nested structures, especially rules that match many initial-screen nodes.
- Give initial-screen images explicit dimensions so completed resources do not reshape the entire layout.
- Compress images and use assets close to their rendered size instead of decoding images much larger than the display area.
- Do not let nonessential video, animation, or audio enter preparation or playback during startup.

## Measure the First Meaningful Frame

Measure startup on the target device with a real AIX package. A single launch on a development machine does not represent cold-start behavior on the device.

Record these points together:

1. The agent begins opening.
2. Required synchronous initialization in `onLoad` finishes.
3. The first frame is submitted.
4. The first frame containing meaningful content appears.
5. Primary initial-screen data finishes loading and the layout stabilizes.

Use `performance.mark()` and `performance.measure()` for application initialization stages. Use screen recording, host performance events, or device logs to confirm when content is actually displayed. Repeat cold-start runs and compare medians or percentiles before and after a change.

```html
<script setup>
export default {
  async onLoad() {
    performance.mark('home-data-start');

    const response = await fetch('https://api.example.com/summary');
    const summary = await response.json();
    this.setData({ summary });

    performance.mark('home-data-end');
    performance.measure(
      'home-data-ready',
      'home-data-start',
      'home-data-end',
    );
  },
};
</script>
```

`performance.measure()` reports JavaScript task duration; it does not by itself prove that a frame has reached the display. Evaluate startup by combining script measurements with first-frame and first-meaningful-frame observations.

## Current Capability Boundary

The runtime can currently parse the `subpackages` and `preloadRule` fields in `app.json`, but its startup and navigation paths do not yet use those fields to perform subpackage loading or subpackage prefetching. Do not treat the presence of these configuration fields as an active startup optimization.

Until the runtime provides complete subpackage scheduling, improve startup by simplifying the entry page, reducing initial-screen components and synchronous initialization, and controlling initial data and resource costs.

Continue with [Performance Metrics](/AIUI/guide/performance-data) to establish a performance baseline. If the problem mainly occurs after the page is visible, see [Runtime Performance](/AIUI/guide/performance-runtime).

title: 启动性能
content:
# 启动性能

AIUI 的启动性能主要取决于：从打开智能体，到用户看到第一个有效画面之前，首个 Page 或 Widget 需要完成多少工作。

AIUI 运行时会在启动阶段读取并解析入口文件，合并全局与页面样式，解析模板并创建节点树，加载首屏使用的自定义组件，执行应用与入口脚本，再把初始 `data` 应用到模板。随后，运行时完成首轮数据绑定、布局和绘制，画面才会提交到屏幕。

因此，优化启动速度的重点不是笼统地减小整个项目，而是缩短首屏关键路径。

## 保持首屏结构精简

首屏模板越大，运行时在首次渲染前需要解析、绑定、布局和绘制的节点就越多。只把用户打开智能体后立即能看到或操作的内容放在入口页面中。

- 避免在首屏挂载当前不可见的大型列表、复杂面板或多层嵌套结构。
- 把非首屏流程拆到后续页面，在用户进入对应流程时再加载。
- 为列表设置合理的初始数量，不要在 `data` 中一次放入完整数据集。
- 减少仅用于包裹布局、但没有实际样式或交互作用的节点。

使用 CSS 隐藏内容并不会让它退出模板解析和节点创建过程。对于启动时不需要的完整功能区，优先从首屏结构中移除，而不是只设置为不可见。

### 将独立页面单元拆成不同 Page

如果首页、详情页和设置页分别承担独立任务，应把它们实现为不同的 Page。不要把所有页面的模板、状态和事件逻辑都放进一个 Page，再通过 `ink:if` 和页面状态切换整套界面。后一种方式会持续扩大入口模板和入口脚本，也会让各页面的生命周期、数据和交互逻辑耦合在一起。

例如，下面的结构把首页和详情页都放在同一个 Page 中，不适合随着功能继续扩展：

```html
<page>
  <view ink:if="{{ currentView === 'home' }}">
    <!-- 首页内容 -->
  </view>

  <view ink:elif="{{ currentView === 'detail' }}">
    <!-- 详情页内容 -->
  </view>
</page>
```

更合适的方式是在 `app.json` 中分别注册两个 Page：

```json
{
  "pages": [
    "pages/home/index",
    "pages/detail/index"
  ]
}
```

用户需要查看详情时，再从首页跳转到详情页：

```javascript
wx.navigateTo({
  url: '/pages/detail/index?id=42'
});
```

这样入口页面只承担首页任务，详情页的模板、状态和业务逻辑也能保持独立。需要用新页面替换当前页面时使用 `wx.redirectTo()`；返回已有页面时使用 `wx.navigateBack()`。

`ink:if` 仍然适合同一页面内的局部条件内容，例如加载态、空状态、错误提示、权限提示或可展开区域。判断标准是：如果这部分内容拥有独立任务、完整布局或独立导航语义，就优先拆成 Page；如果只是当前任务的一种局部状态，则保留在当前 Page 中。完整路由用法参见[路由 API](/AIUI/api/route)。

## 控制首屏自定义组件数量

运行时在解析入口模板时会加载其中引用的自定义组件，并执行组件脚本。组件自身的模板、样式、嵌套组件和初始化代码都会进入启动关键路径。

- 首屏只引用立即需要的自定义组件。
- 避免为了很小的静态片段引入层级很深的组件树。
- 检查嵌套组件是否重复引入相同资源或执行相同初始化。
- 将复杂但非必要的功能放到后续页面，而不是预先挂载在入口页面。

组件化仍然有助于维护代码，但组件边界本身不会自动带来按需加载。应根据首屏是否真正需要该组件来决定是否引用。

## 减少同步脚本和资源初始化

应用脚本、入口脚本以及首屏组件脚本都会在启动阶段执行。模块顶层的同步工作会直接延迟后续生命周期与首帧。

- 不要在模块顶层进行大数组转换、深层对象复制或重复 JSON 解析。
- 不要在启动时创建尚未使用的媒体、设备或其他重量级对象。
- 将非首屏所需的计算和能力初始化推迟到用户进入对应流程之后。
- 谨慎在入口模块中使用 `with { type: 'image' }` 或 `with { type: 'sound' }` 导入资源；运行时会在模块求值时解码图片或初始化声音对象。

`onLoad` 中也应尽快结束同步工作。网络请求可以在首屏先显示稳定的加载状态，返回后再更新页面：

```html
<script setup>
export default {
  data: {
    loading: true,
    items: [],
  },

  async onLoad() {
    const response = await fetch('https://api.example.com/items');
    const items = await response.json();

    this.setData({
      loading: false,
      items,
    });
  },
};
</script>
```

这个方式不会消除网络等待，但可以避免把远程数据作为首帧出现的前置条件。加载中、空状态和失败状态应保持尺寸稳定，减少数据返回后的明显跳动。

## 精简初始 `data` 和数据绑定

入口脚本执行后，运行时会读取初始 `data`，并将这些字段应用到模板绑定。大型对象、长列表和大量表达式会增加初次数据转换与绑定成本。

- 初始 `data` 只保留首屏渲染需要的字段。
- 不要把接口完整响应直接放入页面状态；先提取界面真正使用的数据。
- 避免在多个节点上重复读取同一组深层字段。
- 对一次请求产生的相关变化使用一次 `setData()`，避免连续触发多轮更新。

不要为了减少调用次数而把无关的大对象一起传给 `setData()`。合并更新的目标是减少重复渲染，同时保持每次更新的数据范围清晰、必要。

## 优化首屏样式和媒体

运行时会在首屏建树前解析全局样式与页面样式，并在布局过程中为节点计算样式。首屏图片等资源则可能在首轮更新后继续加载，并在完成后触发新的绘制。

- 删除未使用的全局样式，避免让每个页面都承担无关规则的解析成本。
- 控制复杂选择器和深层节点结构，尤其是会作用于大量首屏节点的规则。
- 为首屏图片提供明确尺寸，避免资源完成后重新改变整体布局。
- 压缩图片并选择接近实际显示尺寸的资源，避免解码远大于显示区域的图片。
- 不要让非必要的视频、动画或音频在启动时自动进入准备或播放流程。

## 测量首个有效画面

启动优化应在目标设备和真实 AIX 包上测量。开发机中的一次启动结果不能代表设备上的冷启动表现。

建议同时记录以下时间点：

1. 智能体开始打开。
2. `onLoad` 中必要的同步初始化结束。
3. 第一个画面提交。
4. 首个包含有效内容的画面出现。
5. 首屏主要数据加载并稳定显示。

用 `performance.mark()` 和 `performance.measure()` 记录业务初始化阶段；用录屏、宿主性能事件或设备日志确认真正显示到屏幕的时间。重复进行冷启动测试，并使用中位数或分位数比较改动前后结果。

```html
<script setup>
export default {
  async onLoad() {
    performance.mark('home-data-start');

    const response = await fetch('https://api.example.com/summary');
    const summary = await response.json();
    this.setData({ summary });

    performance.mark('home-data-end');
    performance.measure(
      'home-data-ready',
      'home-data-start',
      'home-data-end',
    );
  },
};
</script>
```

`performance.measure()` 只能说明 JavaScript 任务花了多久，不能单独证明画面已经显示。评估启动体验时，应把脚本测量与首帧、首个有效画面一起观察。

## 当前能力边界

当前运行时可以解析 `app.json` 中的 `subpackages` 和 `preloadRule` 字段，但启动与导航路径尚未依据这些字段执行分包加载或分包预下载。不要把配置字段本身当成已经生效的启动优化。

在运行时提供完整的分包调度能力之前，优先通过精简入口页面、减少首屏组件和同步初始化、控制初始数据及资源成本来改善启动体验。

继续阅读[性能数据](/AIUI/guide/performance-data)，了解需要建立的性能基线；如果问题主要发生在页面已经显示之后，请参考[运行时性能](/AIUI/guide/performance-runtime)。

title: Developing with AI
content:
# Developing with AI

In Rokid AIUI agent development, using AI-assisted development has become the standard way to improve efficiency. By introducing the **AIUI Agent Development Skill**, you can enable your AI assistant to deeply understand AIUI framework conventions, component APIs, and best practices.

## Install the Skill

You can use the [vercel-labs/skills](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills) ecosystem to integrate AIUI development capabilities into your project with a single command:

```bash
# Install the AIUI-related Skill into the current project
npx skills add https://github.com/jsar-project/AIUI/tree/main/skills/aiui-dev
```

## Features and Usage

`aiui-dev` is a professional Skill for AIUI agent development. It provides a complete AIUI development context for coding agents, so the AI does not just generate generic frontend code, but can assist according to AIUI project structure, page conventions, component systems, and design constraints.

### Core Capabilities
- **Understand AIUI project structure**: Recognizes core directories and configuration files such as `AGENTS.md`, `app.json`, `app.js`, `pages/`, `widgets/`, `workers/`, and `assets/`, helping you scaffold or organize AIUI projects.
- **Generate standards-compliant page code**: Understands the recommended `.ink` single-file component structure in AIUI, including `<script def>`, `<script setup>`, `<page>`, and `<style>`, making it suitable for directly generating page prototypes and business pages.
- **Handle page configuration and data modeling**: Can help you design page input structures and UI component contracts based on fields such as `page.json`, `description`, `schema`, and `data` in page definitions.
- **Write AIUI templates and styles**: Familiar with WXML data binding, conditional rendering, built-in components, and WXSS/Flexbox layout rules, allowing it to generate AIUI page structures and style code more accurately.
- **Use built-in AIUI components and APIs**: Covers common component capabilities as well as Web APIs and `wx.*` compatible APIs for scenarios such as network requests, voice, camera, Canvas, storage, and routing.
- **Follow AIUI design guidelines**: Understands AIUI constraints around sizing, card-based layout, primary colors, border radius, borders, and visual limitations for wearable scenarios, helping you generate interfaces that better fit the device experience.
- **Assist with debugging and migration**: Can provide advice that is closer to the actual runtime when troubleshooting AIUI pages, completing API calls, or migrating WeChat Mini Program-style code to AIUI.

### Install into a Coding Agent
You can install this Skill into the coding agent you are using through the `skills` command. `skills` supports project-level or global installation, and also supports installing into different agents.

- Use the `npx skills add ...` command above to install `aiui-dev` into the current project.
- If you want to learn about supported agents, installation methods, parameter options, and more usage details for `skills`, refer to [skills - npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/skills).

After installation, the AI assistant can help you with page generation, API integration, style authoring, troubleshooting, and design alignment based on AIUI-specific context.

title: 使用 AI 开发
content:
# 使用 AI 开发

在 Rokid AIUI 智能体开发中，利用 AI 辅助开发已经成为提升效率的标准方式。通过引入 **AIUI Agent 开发 Skill**，你可以让 AI 助手深度理解 AIUI 框架规范、组件 API 及最佳实践。

## 安装 Skill

你可以利用 [vercel-labs/skills](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills) 生态，通过一行命令将 AIUI 的开发能力集成到你的项目中：

```bash
# 将 AIUI 相关 Skill 安装到当前项目
npx skills add https://github.com/jsar-project/AIUI/tree/main/skills/aiui-dev
```

## 功能介绍与使用

`aiui-dev` 是一套面向 AIUI 智能体开发的专业 Skill。它为 Coding Agent 提供了完整的 AIUI 开发上下文，让 AI 不只是生成通用前端代码，而是能够按照 AIUI 的项目结构、页面规范、组件体系和设计约束来协助开发。

### 核心功能
- **理解 AIUI 项目结构**：识别 `AGENTS.md`、`app.json`、`app.js`、`pages/`、`widgets/`、`workers/` 和 `assets/` 等核心目录与配置，帮助你搭建或整理 AIUI 工程。
- **生成符合规范的页面代码**：理解 AIUI 推荐的 `.ink` 单文件组件结构，包括 `<script def>`、`<script setup>`、`<page>` 和 `<style>`，适合直接产出页面原型和业务页面。
- **掌握页面配置与数据描述**：能基于 `page.json` 或页面定义中的 `description`、`schema`、`data` 等字段，帮助你设计页面输入数据结构和 UI 组件契约。
- **编写 AIUI 模板与样式**：熟悉 WXML 数据绑定、条件渲染、内置组件，以及 WXSS/Flexbox 布局规则，能更准确地生成 AIUI 页面结构与样式代码。
- **使用 AIUI 内置组件与 API**：覆盖常见组件能力，以及 Web API 和 `wx.*` 兼容 API，例如网络请求、语音、相机、Canvas、存储、路由等场景。
- **遵循 AIUI 设计规范**：理解 AIUI 在尺寸、卡片式布局、主色、圆角、边框和可穿戴场景视觉限制上的约束，帮助你生成更贴合设备体验的界面。
- **辅助调试与迁移**：在排查 AIUI 页面问题、补全接口调用、或将微信小程序风格代码迁移到 AIUI 时，能提供更贴近实际运行环境的建议。

### 安装到 Coding Agent
你可以通过 `skills` 命令将这个 Skill 安装到你正在使用的 Coding Agent 中。`skills` 支持项目级或全局安装，也支持安装到不同的 Agent。

- 使用上面的 `npx skills add ...` 命令即可将 `aiui-dev` 安装到当前项目。
- 如果你希望了解 `skills` 的适用 Agent、安装方式、参数选项和更多用法，请参考 [skills - npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/skills)。

安装后，AI 助手就能基于 AIUI 的专有上下文来协助你完成页面生成、接口调用、样式编写、问题排查和设计对齐等开发工作。

Welcome to AIUI! AIUI is an AI-native GUI local agent framework designed specifically for AI + AR. It emphasizes both agent-oriented interaction and organizational patterns, while also integrating local device-side capabilities to help developers build truly deployable intelligent agents. To help you develop agents more efficiently, we provide a complete documentation guide:
